allocationRule: v1: every actual or refunded cost row goes to its nearest run (itself or an ancestor) that declared a produced occurrence; per (that run, UTC day of the cost row, org of the cost row) it is split over the run's produced occurrences in proportion to quantity (default 1 = equal shares) by cumulative rounding at 10 decimals in occurrence-id order, so the shares sum exactly to the cost; same split on billed gross, frozen net and vendor actual; no such run = produced none. Standard cost on reuse: a consumption resolves to the latest producing occurrence of the same (outcome, subject) declared at or before it (else the earliest declared later), among those declared before the end of the consumption's UTC day; the first consumption of an occurrence is paid by its spend, every later one is charged the same production cost as a reuse gain, on the consuming run's org and UTC day.
